title: Silencing BLNK protects against interleukin-1beta-induced chondrocyte injury through the NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Cheng, Yi; Li, Feng; Zhang, Wen-Sheng; Zou, Guo-You; Shen, Yi-Xin
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨BLNK基因沉默通过NF-kappaB通路对骨关节炎软骨细胞损伤的保护作用，属于纯湿实验与表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteoarthritis (OA) is the most common joint disease in the elderly and is characterized by the progressive degeneration of articular cartilage. It is necessary to study the molecular pathology of OA. This study aimed to explore the role and mechanism of BLNK in regulating interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta)-induced chondrocyte injury and OA progression. METHODS: GSE1919 (5 normal samples and 5 OA samples) was downloaded from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. The limma package in R software was used to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between control and OA-affected cartilage. Gene ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analyses of the differentially expressed genes were also performed. Apoptosis was assessed by flow cytometry. An OA rat model was established, and the relative expression of BLNK was assessed by real time quantitative PCR (qRT-PCR) and immunohistochemical staining. The expression of collagen II, MMP9, p65 and p-p65 was measured by Western blot analysis. Moreover, inflammatory factors (TNF-alpha and IL-18) were assessed by ELISA. The NF-kappaB inhibitor JSH-23 was used to assess the impact of BLNK on the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. RESULTS: In total, 1318 DEGs were identified between normal and OA-affected cartilage according to the criteria (P-value <0.05 and |logFC > 1|). These DEGs were mainly enriched in the NF-kappaB pathway. BLNK was highly expressed in OA cartilage tissue and injured chondrocytes. Silencing BLNK significantly downregulated the IL-1beta-induced apoptosis of chondrocytes. Silencing BLNK partially increased collagen II expression and downregulated MMP13 expression. Moreover, silencing BLNK partially decreased TNF-alpha and IL-18 expression. BLNK silencing inhibited the activation of NF-kappaB in OA. Silencing BLNK delayed OA progression through the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. CONCLUSION: Silencing BLNK delayed OA progression and IL-1beta-induced chondrocyte injury by regulating the NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨关节炎（OA）是老年人中最常见的关节疾病，其特征是关节软骨的进行性退化。研究OA的分子病理机制十分必要。本研究旨在探讨BLNK在调节白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）诱导的软骨细胞损伤及OA进展中的作用和机制。方法：从基因表达综合数据库（GEO）下载GSE1919数据集（包含5个正常样本和5个OA样本）。使用R软件中的limma包识别对照组与OA受累软骨之间的差异表达基因（DEGs）。对差异表达基因进行了基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路分析。通过流式细胞术评估细胞凋亡。建立OA大鼠模型，并通过实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）和免疫组织化学染色评估BLNK的相对表达。通过Western blot分析检测胶原蛋白II、MMP9、p65和p-p65的表达。此外，通过ELISA评估炎症因子（TNF-α和IL-18）。使用NF-κB抑制剂JSH-23评估BLNK对NF-κB信号通路的影响。结果：根据标准（P值<0.05且|logFC>1|），共鉴定出1318个正常与OA受累软骨之间的差异表达基因。这些差异表达基因主要富集在NF-κB通路中。BLNK在OA软骨组织和受损软骨细胞中高表达。沉默BLNK显著下调了IL-1β诱导的软骨细胞凋亡。沉默BLNK部分增加了胶原蛋白II的表达并下调了MMP13的表达。此外，沉默BLNK部分降低了TNF-α和IL-18的表达。BLNK沉默抑制了OA中NF-κB的激活。沉默BLNK通过NF-κB信号通路延缓了OA进展。结论：沉默BLNK通过调节NF-κB通路延缓了OA进展及IL-1β诱导的软骨细胞损伤。
